list.name: underlying
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT underlying FROM option_greeks ORDER BY underlying;

list.name: expiry
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT expiry FROM option_greeks WHERE underlying = '$underlying' ORDER BY expiry DESC;

targets.rawSql:
WITH picked AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$expiry' = 'latest' THEN (SELECT max(expiry) FROM option_greeks WHERE underlying = '$underlying') WHEN '$expiry' LIKE '%-%' THEN to_date(NULLIF('$expiry','latest'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE to_timestamp((NULLIF(regexp_replace('$expiry','\D','','g'),'')::double precision) / 1000)::date END AS expiry
)
SELECT COALESCE(to_char(max(ts) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '') AS value
FROM option_greeks o
JOIN picked p ON o.expiry = p.expiry
WHERE o.underlying = '$underlying';

WITH picked AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$expiry' = 'latest' THEN (SELECT max(expiry) FROM option_greeks WHERE underlying = '$underlying') WHEN '$expiry' LIKE '%-%' THEN to_date(NULLIF('$expiry','latest'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE to_timestamp((NULLIF(regexp_replace('$expiry','\D','','g'),'')::double precision) / 1000)::date END AS expiry
), latest AS (
  SELECT max(ts) AS ts FROM option_greeks o JOIN picked p ON o.expiry = p.expiry WHERE o.underlying = '$underlying'
)
SELECT o.tradingsymbol,
       o.strike,
       o."right",
       o.iv,
       o.delta,
       o.gamma,
       o.theta,
       o.vega,
       o.trade_volume,
       o.ltp,
       o.ts
FROM option_greeks o
JOIN picked p ON o.expiry = p.expiry
JOIN latest l ON o.ts = l.ts
WHERE o.underlying = '$underlying'
ORDER BY o.strike, o."right";
